title.narrative: Strengthening the Rule of Law and Reverse the Regression of Democracy and Human Rights by Revitalizing the Structural Legal Aid Movement

description.narrative:
Outcome 1: Public Trust and Capacity of YLBHI-LBH strengthened as Center for Movement and Advocacy Against Criminalization.
Outcome 2: Strengthen the Effectiveness of Digital Campaigns for the Promotion of Democracy and Human Rights
Outcome 3: The Strengthen of The Civil Society Movement Through the Formation of a Democratic League in the 5 Regions

The direct beneficiaries of this program are: 1) YLBHI and 18 LBH-YLBHI offices in 5 regions in Indonesia; 2) LBH YLBHI public lawyers who utilize anti-criminal studies and case handling SOPs;3) Advocates/Prospective Advocates and LBH networks in 5 regions in Indonesia who have received anti-criminalization training; 4) Victims of criminalization cases, both individuals and community groups in 5 regions in Indonesia; 5) Community Network from various sectors working for the promotion of democracy and rule of law;
While the indirect beneficiaries of this program are: 1) The general public who gain knowledge about the results of anti-criminalization research and anti-criminalization advocacy; 2). The general public is exposed to information about democracy and human rights campaigns; 3) Community paralegals who receive assistance from LBH YLBHI in 18 offices that handle criminal cases and carry out democracy and human rights campaigns.
